srg43.note: No integral parameter set in the legal degree window. 43 ≢ 1 (mod 4), so there is also no conference graph. Every SRG is either a conference graph or has integer eigenvalues, so there is no strongly regular graph on 43 vertices with degree in [18,24]. That excludes an SRG (5,5,43)-graph. It is not a bound on R(5,5).
